goal: Deprecate encrypting existing wallets to steer users toward creating encrypted wallets from the start
Prevents fund loss from invalidated backups and removes unpurged plaintext key remnants on disk
agreement: Broad support with all reviewer suggestions addressed and verified
Support noting creating a new encrypted wallet and moving funds is cleaner (pablomartin4btc)
Verified test coverage is preserved for encryption persistence on reload (Eunovo)
Approvals on implementation and concept (achow101, w0xlt, pseudoramdom, rkrux)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because post-creation encryption risks fund loss when restoring from pre-encryption backups
Encrypting existing wallets leaves plaintext keys on disk and can alter descriptor spending rules
